stem.text: A car travelling in a straight line at a speed of $30\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ passes near a stationary observer while sounding its horn. The true frequency of sound from the horn is $400\,\text{Hz}$.
The speed of sound in air is $336\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the change in the frequency of the sound heard by the observer as the car passes?
